caption:
Free Google AI Plus for 1 year, for Indian college students. Claim before 31 December 2026.

Google says eligible students get Google AI Plus, worth about Rs 4,000, free for a year, with higher Gemini limits and 400 GB of storage. Check eligibility at one.google.com/ai-student.

Read the terms on the official page before signing up.

Source: Google India blog, Beebom.

Send this to your class group before the deadline.
